title: Piano High Score
description:
⚠️ Requires a digital piano or MIDI keyboard.

Piano High Score is an arcade style rhythm game for your real MIDI keyboard. Load your own MIDI files (you can even drag and drop!) and just press play. Play each note when it's on the line, build up a combo, and compete on leaderboards. There's a leaderboard for each song!

🎵 Load your own MIDI files (drag and drop supported).

🎵 Practice mode for focusing on specific parts of a song.

🏆 Online leaderboards for each song.

💾 Your best scores are saved for each song.

🎵 No subscriptions or extra accounts to make.

🎵 Some songs are included to get you started, along with popular scales.
description_short: Everything you love about rhythm games, brought to your digital piano. Load your own MIDI files, play on real keys, and climb online leaderboards.
